shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in a yellow shirt sits in the plant-side window seat and tells a story about a holiday trip, and a man in a red shirt sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with the full table and all three seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a purple shirt enters and sits in the counter-side window seat. He asks a question about the story, and a woman in a yellow shirt answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt continues the story.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with the full table, the plant-end seat, and both window-side seats in frame.
